newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Quanex FY97 EPS view lowered.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Quanex FY97 EPS view lowered.

text.p: --Hanifen, Imhoff Inc said Wednesday it had reduced its fiscal 1997 earnings per share estimate on Quanex Corp to $2.80 from $2.90. It maintained its 1998 estimate at $3.80 per share.

--Hanifen, Imhoff said it adjusted its forecast to account for the company's sale of its La Salle Steel unit this month and the sale of the Tube Group by fiscal year-end, and a 35 percent corporate tax rate in both 1997 and 1998, down from 42 percent in recent years.

--"Quanex is positioned to generate EPS substantially above Wall Street expectations over the next three to four years, and its restructuring to increase long-term growth and reduce its cyclicality should begin to be reflected by a higher P/E valuation over the next 12-18 months," Hanifen, Imhoff said in a report.
